out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at ALL (3) handwashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. STAFF WERE USING NAPKINS AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH PAPER TOWELS AND SOAP. PLEASE REITERATE HANDWASHING PROCEDURES TO STAFF.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER WAS OBSERVED ONISTE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM SHOULD BE ONSITE AT THE ESTABLISHMENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.
